phase.draw: draw from the University table (with cards).
phase.production: Parks, Quarries and Mines produce, automatically.
phase.upkeep: each Mine pays {{coal}} Coal; without Coal it idles next turn.
phase.actions: up to {{n}} actions; trading costs no action.

action.explore: Explore (1 action): reveal a hex next to a revealed hex on your board.
action.survey: Survey (1 action): reveal the subsoil of a hex in your range — only you see it.
action.build: Build (1 action + cost): within the Village ({{range}}) or an Outpost range; up to {{slots}} slots per hex.
action.upgrade: Upgrade (1 action + cost): levels 2 and 3 need a Workshop.
action.bank: Bank (free): buys at value {{buy}}, sells at value {{sell}}; change goes to the bank.
action.trade: Trade (free): offer to another player; they accept, decline or counter.
action.victory: Victory: hoard a resource threshold or have structures on {{hexes}} hexes, checked at round end.
